batch: T10-AUTH6B trusted RuntimeClient bridge + private gate receipts
scope: Pure Node: the real bridge, the real AUTH-6 flow and the real AUTH-5 private port, with a labeled Fake RuntimeClient (real facade signatures) and labeled Fake private services. No browser, Playwright, worker-entry, provider, deploy, DB, or real Coordinator.

browserCompatibilityFix.change: AuthPermit.target/url now declare `| undefined` so the orchestrator AuthPermit (target?: NodeTarget | undefined) is assignable under exactOptionalPropertyTypes. This is the one semantic line of the AUTH-6B compatibility fix; behavior is unchanged.

facadeCompatibility.how: AuthRuntimeClient narrows the four real facade methods; `type _FacadeIsCompatible = RuntimeClient extends AuthRuntimeClient ? true : never` fails the build on drift.
facadeCompatibility.negativeProof: A deliberately wrong port (grantAuth(proof: string, request: string)) makes tsc fail with "Type true is not assignable to type never", so the assertion is not vacuous.

commands: cd apps/worker && node --test test/auth-flow.test.mjs test/auth-runtime.test.mjs   # 18/18 (11 flow re-runs + 7 new bridge cases)

cases.name: form flow runs the fixed order once through the fake runtime
one OTP at most, and never a second wait after a criterion failure
storage_state prepares without navigating, then navigates once
record, observation, capture and finish failures never yield success
missing or unsupported configuration is blocked, never passed
unknown, raw, or getter-throwing codes fall back to constants
none never touches material, the port, or the adapters
abort cancels the flow without any success or capture
the private ticket and capture material stay out of the outcome
storage_state material takes only the canonical resolveAuth shape
the port must belong to the same session as the binding
the bridge forwards the frozen proof and keeps the lease token private
permits and port bindings are re-verified against the frozen binding
receipts cannot be borrowed, replayed, or settled twice
expiry, revocation, and service failures stop the flow without caching
a missing service blocks instead of fabricating a capture
construction refuses an incomplete client, proof, or inactive binding
service methods keep their receiver and a throwing accessor is contained

summary.note: Raw runner totals; earlier-batch cases are re-runs, not accumulated coverage.

coverage: real proof is copied and frozen once; every client call receives that same frozen object
beginAuthExecution runs before the matching browser effect; its receipt reaches exactly one recordAuth call and never an outcome/Step/enumerable return
leaseToken, ticket, username and password never appear in the outcome or in the returned bridge objects
no ordinary grant/record channel is ever called
permits are re-verified against the frozen binding on all 12 tuple fields plus action/slot/target (14 tampering negatives, all LEASE_EXPIRED with zero primitives)
port bindings from another session are refused before beginAuthExecution
receipts cannot be borrowed (unbegun grant), replayed (second begin for one grant), or used across sessions/grants
concurrent begins for one grant: exactly one reaches the service
mid-flow LEASE_EXPIRED from beginAuthExecution stops the flow with no capture and no cached acceptance on the next call
RATE_LIMITED from grantAuth and POLICY_DENIED from recordAuth/authorizeExport block without a success or a fabricated stateRef
each of the 7 missing services blocks the flow (SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; the export gate surfaces VALIDATION_ERROR because the port accepts only three codes)
construction refuses an incomplete client, an empty leaseToken, and an inactive binding
notImplemented: no real Coordinator material/OTP/criterion/capture/finish service and no Worker.once wiring; Stage.auth stays unwired
no service-verified ticket or stateRef: positive capture evidence is a Fake service only
the export gate maps a missing CAS service to VALIDATION_ERROR (the port only understands three codes)
no DB/PG path in this batch; pi owns the service side
no real browser / session.ts integration; Ego verification stays paused
